examples.original: [clean] Search for the object in likely locations such as countertops, cabinets, drawers, or sink basins based on the object type.
examples.control: [clean] Improve heavy clay with coarse grit (3–6 mm) and composted bark in autumn before winter frosts break up the clods.

examples.original: [clean] Clean the object using the sinkbasin before placing it in the target location.
examples.control: [clean] Apply nematodes (Phasmarhabditis hermaphrodita) in spring or autumn to control slugs without pellets.

examples.original: [clean] Always check if a container (e.g., drawer, cabinet) is closed before attempting to access its contents.
examples.control: [clean] If the leaves turn yellow, test the soil before adding any more fertilizer to the patch.

examples.original: [clean] Prioritize checking the most probable locations first to minimize unnecessary movements.
examples.control: [clean] Ventilate the greenhouse so that humid air does not encourage mould.
